metadata.case_name: FOK SHU WOON v. KATHERINE POON LING-YEE AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Teacher (primarily physical education but has other subjects)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Teacher (returned to his former employment without any loss of earnings)

source: He underwent an operation for repair of a ruptured left eyeball and received stitches for facial lacerations.
injuries.icd_description: Ocular laceration or rupture with prolapse or loss of intraocular tissue, unilateral

injuries.description: left traumatic cataract with total loss of vision in that eye
source: Unfortunately, after discharge from hospital the Plaintiff developed left traumatic cataract which has developed to such an extent that he now has total loss of vision in that eye.

injuries.description: facial lacerations and residual scarring to his face
source: He underwent an operation for repair of a ruptured left eyeball and received stitches for facial lacerations.
The Plaintiff has some residual scarring to his face.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

manifestations.description: Total loss of vision in left eye
Loss of accommodation (ability to alter focus for objects at various distances)
Loss of stereoscopic or three-dimensional vision
Frequent relatively minor irritations to the left eye including glare, easy fatigability, congestion or redness, itchiness, gritty sensations

treatments_received: Detained at Queen Elizabeth Hospital for 2 days
Operation for repair of a ruptured left eyeball
treatments_future: Further operation for removal of the cataract during the next two or three months
Regular follow-up treatment for at least one year
Contact lenses (including replacement from time to time; probably a special new soft lens costing $600 - $700)

losses.description: Total loss of vision in the left eye
Residual scarring to his face which will become noticeable when he changes to contact lenses

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to indulge in jumping and somersaulting necessary to physical education and the trampoline; advised not to take part in ball-games; loss of confidence and ability to enjoy physical sports

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Hon v. Cheng Wai & Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: 100% loss of vision of one eye and scarring
